items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I went in with him, with Dick Stabile and all these people that was with Ben Bernie.

ctx.x: And I never went back to Minneapolis. And, from that -- I don't know I was around there and I did some things with Ben Bernie, was -- so when he went in the College Inn, I went in with him, with Dick Stabile and all these people that was with Ben Bernie.
Yeah. What did you think of Dick Stabile.
